text:
Anya CS: Quick weekly check-in on account health — specifically p95/p99 latency by route/model and streaming vs non-streaming. Two onboarding customers saw tail issues this week.

Mike CSM: Summary: overall usage +9% WoW, spend +7%. Onboard cohort (BrightPath, NovaEdge) reporting p99 spikes on chat.generate when streaming is on.

Raj Onboard: BrightPath specifics: p95 ~240ms, p99 spikes to ~1.1s when concurrent streams >25. Observed increase in KV cache misses and a few 502s.

Lisa Observability: We saw a pattern: cache churn correlates with p99. Example trace: `trace_id=tp-47b` route=chat.generate model=redwood-3b-quant mode=streaming. Cache miss rate >20% during spikes.

Mike CSM: Error impact: 0.35% 502s in peak windows. Customer flagged degraded UX during onboarding demo.

Anya CS: Renewal risk: BrightPath renewal in 5 weeks. If p99 >900ms consistently we should offer credits + remediation.

Raj Onboard: Implemented temporary mitigation: reduced max_streams_per_session to 6 for BrightPath at 14:00 PT yesterday — p99 improved to ~820ms for ~5 hours.

Lisa Observability: Proposed fixes: 1) KV pinning for hot prefixes, 2) adaptive micro-batching for streaming. Suggest canary for NovaEdge.

Mike CSM: Finance note — streaming fallback to sync increases token spend ~5% per 1k reqs. Add to renewal cost estimate.

Anya CS: Action items: Eng to open ticket for cache-pinning (Raj), Ops to schedule micro-batching canary tomorrow 09:00 PT (Lisa), CSM to draft renewal mitigation + cost appendix (Mike).

Raj Onboard: I'll open ticket with traces and config diffs.

Lisa Observability: Links and query: https://telemetry.redwood/trace/tp-47b and `latency_tail(route="chat.generate", model="redwood-3b-quant", mode="streaming")`. Recommend p99 alert at 850ms for BrightPath.

redwood-bot: Canary scheduled: rollout/cache-pinning -> NovaEdge at 2024-06-11T09:00:00Z.

Mike CSM: Post canary metrics in thread. If no improvement escalate.

Anya CS: Thanks team — reconvene next week. :calendar:
